business_summary: Wuxi Huaguang Environment & Energy Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the energy and environmental protection business. The company provides circulating fluidized bed boilers, pulverized coal boilers, waste incineration boilers, biomass boilers, gas turbine waste heat boilers, and desulfurization and denitrification equipment. It also provides engineering, procurement, and construction services for traditional thermal power and new energy photovoltaic power plants; thermal power operation and related power services; photovoltaic power generation and operation services. In addition, the company offers solid waste disposal engineering and system integration services including municipal solid waste, kitchen waste, sewage, sludge, fly ash, etc.; flue gas treatment such as desulfurization and denitrification engineering; municipal engineering and other engineering services; and solid waste operation and disposal projects, including municipal solid waste incineration projects, food waste disposal, sludge and algae sludge treatment. The company was formerly known as Wuxi Huaguang Boiler Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Wuxi Huaguang Environment & Energy Group Co., Ltd. in June 2020. Wuxi Huaguang Environment & Energy Group Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Wuxi, the People's Republic of China.
